## Goal
- Build the owner-mandated IVX ENGINEERING OPERATING SYSTEM (24/7 autonomous engineering mapping): 12 AI teams under IVX Senior Developer, continuous-loop task pipeline with owner-approval + RM-only deploy rules, 2-hour reports — deploy and live-verify it (previous FINAL AI GATEWAY HARDENING mandate is closed VERIFIED).

## Constraints & Preferences
- No simulated success; no VERIFIED without GitHub commit SHA + Render deployment ID + automated test results + live health verification (owner rule 5)
- Only TEAM-12 (Release Manager AI) may merge/tag/deploy; production changes always require owner approval; owner Ivan Cifuentes is sole production authority
- Never create a second IVX app; keep existing Expo app; build reusable modules into IVX Core Platform
- Every 2 hours publish: completed tasks, active tasks, blockers, deployments, production health, next priorities
- Authorized repo ONLY: ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest (gate blocker GITHUB_REPO_UNAUTHORIZED enforced); no duplicate deployments; redact secret values
- Owner GitHub writes need `confirm:true` + `confirmText:"CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"`; new approval phrase for engineering deploy approvals: `CONFIRM_IVX_PRODUCTION_APPROVAL`
- App Factory FA-01..FA-50 only AFTER IVX production is stable

## Key Decisions
- Enforce owner rules in code, not prose: pure state machine (no I/O) for testability; RM-only + owner-approval + evidence gates return typed blockers
- Teams registered honestly as REGISTERED_STANDBY (no fake "verified working" claims)
- Reuse qa-chat-reporter pattern (service-role Supabase REST) for 2h report posting; ticker unref'd, never throws
- `github_commit_file` payload MUST nest file fields under `input:{path,content,contentEncoding,message,branch}`; gzip-base64 for large files past edge WAF
- RLS deny-all (no policies) on new engineering tables is intended — service role bypasses, client keys denied
- Owner tokens re-minted via admin generate_link magiclink → /auth/v1/verify; current /tmp/owner_at + /tmp/owner_rt2
